title: Tension rises between Israel and Lebanon as IDF occupies south of Litani river
summary: Israel shows no signs of slowing down its military campaign in Lebanon. It has so far killed at least 1039 people and displaced more than a million in more than three weeks of fighting with the Iran-backed militant group Hezbollah.
